knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Stable attachment lets staff build relationships with ward colleagues, and grasp what patients need, which supports quality.
Frequency and method are changed through the agreed route, with evidence, so the schedule stays in line with infection control.
The system's core output is a work plan that shows tasks, timing, responsibility and standard times.
The limits of ward authority section says ward authority does not override the infection control schedule, the facility's risk classes or the conditions of the service contract.

practicalCriteria: Learner identifies from a sample plan the route for a frequency change, with the clinical management and infection prevention route named
Learner lists three items from a sample ward plan with their frequency and standard time, with all three correct
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Sample ward plan marked by the assessor
Proposal template completed for a sample change
stopWorkCriteria: A proposal would cut a scheduled clean without clinical or infection prevention agreement
